name: Anointed Automation
summary: Open-source .NET / NuGet libraries by Anointed Automation, LLC, stewarded by Alexander Fields. This repository (github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation) is a collection of small, focused, dependency-light C# packages published to NuGet under the AnointedAutomation.* prefix.
license: MIT. AnointedAutomation.Shopify (and portions of AnointedAutomation.Serialization) are derived from ShopifySharp, MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Joshua Harms.
publishing: Work lands on develop. A develop to master pull request auto increments changed package versions; merging to master publishes each package whose version is newer than NuGet.org.

packages.description: Algorithms for .NET with no dependencies, starting with a pure C# QR code encoder (ISO/IEC 18004) with Reed-Solomon error correction and automatic version and mask selection.
packages.notes: QrEncoder.Encode(text, ecc) returns a QrMatrix (Size, IsDark(x, y)). Pair with Imaging to render.

packages.description: ASP.NET Core middleware and filters for API key authentication, IP blacklisting, invalid endpoint tracking and idle time memory cleanup.
packages.notes: Note the namespace is AnointedAutomation.APIMiddleware (singular) while the package id is plural.

packages.description: Models Biblical concepts as .NET types: love as a behavior tree, a moral reality that reads acts against God's character, and an epistemics engine that checks claims for consistency.
packages.notes: Mathematics supplies a catalog of FoundationalClaim values for the EpistemicLedger.

packages.description: Shared enumerations for AnointedAutomation packages: payment types, providers, transaction and subscription statuses, payment operations, card types, webhook events, and moderation categories.
Renders QR codes from AnointedAutomation.Algorithms to SVG and PNG using only the .NET base class library, with no third party image dependency.
packages.notes: QrRenderer.ToSvg(matrix, moduleSize = 8, quietZone = 4) returns a string; ToPng(...) returns byte[].

packages.description: A lightweight log message model with severity levels, automatic caller detection and a static LogAdded event for routing logs.
packages.notes: Namespace is AnointedAutomation.Optimization.Logging (historical). Factories: LogMessage.Info, Error, Critical, Celebrate, Informational.

packages.description: A curated catalog of laws, theories, and conjectures from logic, mathematics, physics, and chemistry, modeled as foundational claims for the AnointedAutomation.Concepts epistemics engine.
packages.notes: Each catalog exposes a static All list.

packages.description: On demand garbage collection helper that forces a full collection and tries to return unused memory to the operating system.
packages.notes: Used by APIMiddlewares EndpointAccessMiddleware for idle time cleanup.

packages.description: Plain POCO models for user accounts, billing and payments, single sign-on identities (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Facebook, Shopify), and standard API response envelopes.
packages.notes: User.SSO holds one slot per provider: Google (GoogleObjects), Microsoft (MicrosoftUser), Apple (AppleSignIn), Facebook (FacebookLogin), Shopify (AnointedAutomation.Shopify.Customer). A null slot means never linked. User.Emails holds every address (UserEmail, UserEmailSource) and is stored directly under Email; each UserEmail may carry ShopifyCustomerId (long?, the Shopify customer it maps to) and ShopifyLinkedAt; User.Email mirrors the IsPrimary entry.

packages.description: ASP.NET Core helpers: an in memory IFormFile, a hybrid casing System.Text.Json naming convention, and a GraphQL response envelope reader.
packages.notes: Hybrid casing: reference types serialize PascalCase, value types camelCase.

packages.description: Reusable optimization utilities: CSV/DataTable/DataReader helpers, chunking, string helpers, Roman numerals, JSON flattening, file management, and null-safe JsonElement/BsonDocument field accessors.
packages.notes: ToChunks<T>(chunkSize) is an extension on IEnumerable<T>.

packages.description: A MongoDB helper and generic repository base for .NET, with CRUD, paging, aggregation, index management, BSON class maps and casing conventions.
packages.notes: Call HybridCasing.Register once at startup, before any Mongo operation. MongoRepository<TDoc> is abstract (protected ctor taking IMongoHelper and a collection name).

packages.description: A generic repository and helper for MySQL over Entity Framework Core and the Pomelo provider.
packages.notes: GenericRepository<T> wraps any DbContext: GetByIdAsync, GetAllAsync, FindAsync, FindSingleAsync.

packages.description: Shared serialization helpers: naming rules (camel, Pascal, snake and the hybrid value/reference casing rule), System.Text.Json casing convention, presets and UTC DateTime converter, tolerant Newtonsoft.Json converters, and lenient JsonElement readers. No MongoDB dependency.
packages.notes: JsonPresets exposes frozen options (SnakeCase, CamelCase, CaseInsensitive, IgnoreNulls, Api and more). AnointedJson.ConfigureApi applies the full API wire config to a host.

packages.description: Plain Newtonsoft.Json POCO models for the Shopify Admin REST API (customers, orders, products, fulfillments, inventory, refunds, transactions, webhooks and more), derived from ShopifySharp's REST entities. Models only: no HTTP client, no services, no GraphQL types.
packages.notes: Derived from ShopifySharp (MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Joshua Harms); see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the package.
